ValidationRule.description: R-G12: an in-kind gift is one gift with one number. Two figures that could drift apart would make a report of what the organization received disagree with a report of what it valued.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "In-kind"), ISBLANK(Original_Gift__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Fair_Market_Value__c)), Amount__c <> Fair_Market_Value__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The amount and the fair market value of an in-kind gift are the same number: what your organization values the goods or services at. Enter the same figure in both, or change the type if this gift was money.
